name: Check profile generator

on:
  pull_request:
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  verify:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 5
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 22
          cache: npm
      - run: npm ci
      - name: Install SVG renderer
        run: sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends librsvg2-bin
      - run: npm run verify

name: Update public profile

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: "17,47 * * * *"
  workflow_dispatch:
  push:
    branches: [master]
    paths:
      - scripts/**
      - config/**
      - assets/fonts/**
      - package*.json
      - .github/workflows/update-public-profile.yml

permissions:
  contents: write

concurrency:
  group: update-public-profile
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  refresh:
    if: github.repository == 'rohitg00/rohitg00' && github.ref == 'refs/heads/master'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 10
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 22
          cache: npm

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Test generator
        run: npm test

      - name: Install SVG renderer
        run: sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends librsvg2-bin

      - name: Refresh public statistics and banners
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        run: |
          gh --version
          npm run update

      - name: Commit changed public profile data
        run: |
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          git add assets/public-builder-*.png data/public-profile.json data/public-profile-history.json
          if git diff --cached --quiet; then
            exit 0
          fi
          git commit -m "chore: refresh public profile stats"
          git push

# Banner display font

VT323 by Peter Hull is distributed under the SIL Open Font License 1.1. The complete license is in `OFL.txt`.

Source: https://github.com/google/fonts/tree/main/ofl/vt323

The banner follows the public ai-engineering-from-scratch website's `#3553ff` blueprint ink, `#fafaf5` paper, dotted grid, VT323 headings, and serif body text. The generator converts the bundled font's glyph commands to SVG paths, so exported SVGs and PNGs keep the same typography without requiring installed fonts or network access.
